resources.string: Not connected: %1$s. Trying again in %2$d s.
The bridge stopped: %1$s. Checking again in %2$d s.
Allow trading: OFF. Every order is refused.
Nothing yet. Notifications appear here as the bridge sends them.
On the bridge\'s computer, run python -m fidelity_gateway.bridge keygen --notify and paste the key it prints. It is not the extension\'s key.

ws:// is not encrypted. Messages are signed, so they cannot be forged, but anyone on this network can read them. From outside your home network, reach the bridge over a VPN (WireGuard, Tailscale). Never open its port to the internet.
Notifications are off for this app, so nothing will be shown. Turn them on in the system settings.
Tell me when the bridge cannot be reached for 2 minutes
Not an address. Try 192.168.1.10, my-server.lan:8766 or ws://host:8766/notifications.
Keys are 32 to 256 letters, digits or ._~+/=- with no spaces.
